front.title: John
front.theme: FROM DUST TO THE LIGHT OF LIFE

back.kicker: PART TWO · THE LIGHT OF THE WORLD
back.hook: Bread for the hungry. Light for the blind. A hand that will not let go.
paragraphs: In John 6–10 Jesus says I am again and again — the bread of life, the light of the world, the door, the good shepherd — and every one is a gift held out to a man in the dust.
Twelve weeks walk from the loaves on the hillside to the Shepherd's hand, through living water, mercy, freedom, and mud on a blind man's eyes.
items: The full passage in the World English Bible
Five Greek word studies, each with a Live It response
Five Life Application practices and a daily prayer
A Bottom Line and a “Lift Up Your Eyes” benediction
